title: Loss-versus-rebalancing with external proportional transaction costs
abstract: arXiv:2610.21057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study liquidity provision in automated market makers when trading in the external market incurs proportional transaction costs. We consider both separately collected fees and fees retained in reserves. The benchmark is a self-financing strategy holding the same total risky inventory and trading at the external bid and ask. Under continuous external prices and pure arbitrage, the pool and benchmark have identical liquidation wealth whenever the pool fee or the external spread is positive. Thus loss-versus-rebalancing relative to this transaction-cost benchmark is zero, even without a pool fee if the external spread is positive. We then construct retained-fee utility-indifference pools that implement admissible decreasing inventory schedules, and geometric mean pools that implement feasible constant no-trade boundaries for portfolio weights. translated_title: 外部比例交易成本下的损失与再平衡之差（LVR）
translated_abstract: 我们研究当在外部市场进行交易会产生比例交易成本时，自动做市商中的流动性提供问题。我们分别考虑了单独收取的费用以及保留在储备中的费用。我们的基准是一种自融资策略，它持有相同总量的风险库存，并按外部买价和卖价进行交易。在连续外部价格与纯套利的条件下，只要资金池收费或外部买卖价差为正，资金池与基准的清算财富便完全相同。因此，相对于这一考虑交易成本的基准，损失与再平衡之差为零——即使资金池不收费，只要外部价差为正亦是如此。随后，我们构造了保留费用的效用无差异资金池，用以实现容许的递减库存计划；并构造了几何平均资金池，用以实现投资组合权重的可行恒定不交易边界。这些结果为流动性提供提供了一种投资视角的解释：通过选择资金池的（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明，当外部市场存在比例交易成本时，以按外部买卖价交易的自融资策略为基准，自动做市商资金池的损失与再平衡之差（LVR）为零，并通过保留费用的效用无差异资金池与几何平均资金池实现特定的递减库存计划和恒定不交易边界。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that with proportional transaction costs in the external market, an AMM pool's loss-versus-rebalancing is zero relative to a self-financing benchmark trading at the external bid and ask, and constructs retained-fee utility-indifference pools and geometric mean pools that implement decreasing inventory schedules and constant no-trade boundaries.
